title: What If Everyone Worked From Home Two Days a Week?

scenes.text: What if everyone worked from home two days a week? A huge experiment already tried it.
In 2021, Trip.com picked some of its 1,612 Shanghai employees at random for three days in the office, two at home.
Six months later, resignations had fallen by 33 percent among non-managers.
Productivity didn't change. Hybrid workers were just as productive as their office-only coworkers.
Promotions didn't change even after two years. Each avoided quit saved about twenty thousand dollars.
Nobody lost, and the company saved millions. The catch is that this tested two days at home, not five.
